Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Completes the full player-trade handshake using Dropbox's exact Trade-button event, then accepts only the localized trade confirmation prompt after both sides lock their offers.
